name: Skavio USDC Payment Verification & Proof MCP
tagline: Verify USDC transactions and generate evidence PDFs through x402-paid agent tools
description: Connect directly to Skavio's hosted Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint. Discover 18 tools and access public tool metadata without login. Paid functions verify native Circle USDC transfers across seven chains, match the exact recipient and amount, generate payment evidence PDFs, and audit public domain DNS/TLS. Prices: verify 0.02 USDC, match 0.03 USDC, evidence PDF 0.05 USDC, DNS/TLS audit 0.05 USDC. **Payments require an x402 v2-compatible wallet-capable client and USDC on Base; merely installing this MCP does not configure a wallet or grant free paid executions.** Evidence PDFs are not tax invoices. Full setup: https://www.skavio.eu/x402/docs/.

install.notes: Hosted public MCP discovery works without a wallet. To invoke paid tools, configure a separate client that supports x402 v2 settlement with native Circle USDC on Base; no wallet keys or signing data are requested by this listing.
